presentation.label: CC RECALL
presentation.summary: After a pattern reload, pattern change, project load or STOP, the MIDI tracks send their pattern’s CC values at once instead of waiting for each track’s next trig.
presentation.overview: A MIDI track sends a control change when its value changes. When a pattern is reloaded, changed or loaded with its project, or the sequencer stops, the Digitakt puts the track’s saved CC VAL values back on screen but sends them only with the track’s next trig, a note or a lock trig; until then external gear, and the Digitakt’s own effects through FX CONTROL CH, keep the values they last received. With SETTINGS > CC RECALL ticked, each MIDI track with CHAN on sends its pattern’s values straight away instead: the eight CC VAL slots that have a CC SEL, and the mod wheel, breath, pitch bend and aftertouch values, exactly what its next trig would send. The trig still sends them as stock. Unticked, every message goes out as stock.
highlights: A reloaded or changed pattern puts external synths back to its saved CC values at once, playing or stopped.
With FX Track, an effects track resets the delay, reverb, compressor and External Mixer the same way.
Project load sends every MIDI track’s values too.
Sends exactly what the track’s next trig sends; unticked, MIDI output is stock.
usage: Connect a synth to MIDI OUT. On MIDI track A switch CHAN on (SRC page, FUNC + knob A) and set it to the synth’s channel.
On the AMP page set SEL1 to the synth’s filter cutoff CC, and on the FLTR page set VAL1. Save the pattern or the project.
Open SETTINGS and tick CC RECALL.
Turn VAL1 so the synth’s filter moves, then reload the pattern (FUNC + NO): VAL1 jumps back on screen and the synth’s filter follows at once, playing or stopped.
With FX Track also ticked, a MIDI track on FX CONTROL CH resets the delay, reverb, compressor and External Mixer the same way.

steps: Use a build containing CC Recall for the original Digitakt on OS 1.54.
Press SETTINGS and go down to CC RECALL, below SYSTEM, with UP/DOWN.
Press YES to tick or untick it. RIGHT ticks it and LEFT unticks it.

controls.name: CC RECALL
controls.doc: Ticked: after a pattern reload, a pattern change, a project load or STOP, each MIDI track with CHAN on sends its pattern’s CC VAL values (the slots with a CC SEL), mod wheel, breath, pitch bend and aftertouch at once, as its next trig would; the trig still sends them as stock. Ticking it sends nothing by itself. Unticked: stock. Unticked at every power-on; not saved with the project.

limitations: Not saved: CC RECALL starts unticked (stock) at every power-on.
STOP counts as a new pattern for the MIDI tracks, so STOP sends the pattern’s values too, ending a parameter lock or LFO excursion at once.
Every value is sent, whether or not the gear already has it: up to 12 messages a track, one track every clock of the MIDI tracks’ task, all eight within about 0.3 s.
Pitch bend and aftertouch go out as the stock first trig sends them, so a held note can bend back to the pattern’s value.

load.display: No audio-interrupt code; about 20 cycles per MIDI-task clock, 5,200 when a track is sent (emulator)
load.conditions: Emulator: OS 1.54 on Core 2.1, the clock-record handler timed with the MCF5441x instruction-timing model at 250 MHz, zero-wait memory. Ticked and idle: 17-24 cycles per clock of the MIDI tracks' task (297 clocks). A clock that loads and sends one MIDI track with CHAN on (15 parameters, 12 messages): about 5,220 cycles (about 21 µs); a clock that only skips tracks with CHAN off: about 1,630. The module adds no code to the audio interrupt. Not a hardware measurement.

hardware.summary: draadpiraat flashed the module-alone build and a build with FX Track on their Digitakt I, OS 1.54. A first build sent the saved values on a pattern reload but nothing on a pattern change while playing (in and between banks, chain, song mode) until a VAL knob moved or the sequencer stopped and started. With the pattern-record site added, the author reported that CC Recall works completely, alone and with FX Track: a pattern change while playing, in and between banks, in a chain and in song mode, and a reload.
limitations: The current build's result was reported as one statement for the four steps asked.
Project load, STOP alone and several MIDI tracks at once were not reported separately.
Tested for a couple of minutes (recorded as 2), thoroughly, as the author reported.

tests.summary: Author hardware (Digitakt I, OS 1.54, alone and with FX Track): with CC RECALL ticked, a pattern change while playing (also between banks, in a chain and in song mode) and a reload send the MIDI tracks' CC values at once. Emulator: also STOP and a project load; the next trig still sends as stock; with FX Track a reload puts the reverb PRE back at once and CC 24 does not leave MIDI OUT. Unticked: stock.
